rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13839 §§1–8, 83 FR 25343–25347 (PDF pp.1–5). Sections 2–5 prescribe personnel principles, grievance bargaining, workforce restrictions and personnel-record integrity; §6 requires recurring adverse-action reporting/publication; §7 directs regulatory and policy changes, CBA renegotiation, evaluation reports and education. A single completed removal or rule cannot exhaust all commands. EO 14003 §3(c), 86 FR 7231 (PDF p.1), expressly revokes EO 13839 as a whole. Sections 3(e)(v) and 3(f), p.2, identify discipline/performance policies including bargaining agreements for separate review and appropriate rescission/revision. This is not partial revocation of only specified policies. EO 13839 §8(b) preserves CBAs in effect and requires consultation; §§8(a),(c)–(e) preserve statutory authority, lawful implementation, no private rights and severability. Those clauses do not perpetuate independent target commands after whole-order revocation. Past personnel decisions and surviving independently binding rules remain distinct. EO 14148 §2(o) revokes EO 14003, but its full text contains no affirmative restoration of EO 13839. Broad contrary policy and review of implementation cannot substitute for such an act.
remaining_source_action: Obtain personnel rules, policy/CBA changes, adverse-action reports, rule-evaluation and supervisory-education records plus pertinent judicial/agency actions; resolve clause-specific performance/earlier cessation and accrued personnel consequences.
